newsitem.title: CHILE: Belgian PM Dehaene, Chile's Frei hold talks.
newsitem.headline: Belgian PM Dehaene, Chile's Frei hold talks.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene held talks with Chile's President Eduardo Frei on Monday on the first day of his official visit aimed at strengthening trade and political ties.

"We have talked about bilateral relations between Chile and Belgium and how to find ways of reinforcing them, as well as links between this country and the European Union," Dehaene told reporters after meeting Frei at the Moneda presidential palace.
Trade between Chile and Belgium totals around $400 million a year. Belgian companies have also invested heavily in Chile's fast-growing electricity industry.
"In coming years investments will also increase in transport and infrastructure," said Dehaene.
Chile and the European Union signed an economic co-operation agreement at the Florence summit in June which is expected evolve eventually into a full free trade agreement.
